verdict_reason: The file is part of a rebase fix that reverts main's EUDPA-696 commodity-group review cards to a per-line layout the ticket does not ask for, leaving commodity-cards.js orphaned and importing a renamed export.

todos.issue: This file arrives in rebase-fix commit 714a8f5 ('Restore the pre-rebase check-answers view model'), which reverts main's EUDPA-696 Design Release 2.1 commodity cards: description-of-goods.js now builds one card per commodity line via speciesCards -> speciesCardActions (Change hidden text 'commodity N', by line index), where main built one card per commodity group via commodityCards (commodity-cards.js:16-45, hidden text copy.hidden.commodity(heading)). commodity-cards.js and species/species-block.js are left in the tree with no importer, and commodity-cards.js:8 still imports changeAction, which the same commit renamed to cardAction in rows/change-link.js, so it would fail to load if anything imported it. EUDPA-776 only removes the contact address page; reverting the review page's commodity layout is a behaviour change the ticket does not ask for, and two card mechanisms now sit side by side.
todos.fix: Must: the check-answers Description of the goods section renders main's EUDPA-696 commodity-group cards (one Change action per group, through the one change-link helper), with only the contact-address removal on top, and no orphaned second card mechanism remains. One way: redo the conflict resolution against main, keeping commodity-cards.js, species-block.js, additional-details.js and changeAction, and delete species-card-actions.js with the other restored species-cards files; if the per-line layout is genuinely wanted, take it to its own ticket and delete commodity-cards.js and species-block.js there.
